arguments.description: Replace the hall with ONLY one separate narrow timber staircase module curving around the right side of an implied trunk: clearly spaced sturdy steps, carved handrail, reinforced landing at top and bottom, supporting braces and bindings. No tree trunk, house, terrain or canopy. Preserve the exact refined native-pixel style, rich chestnut palette, shallow three-quarter front game view and upper-left light. Transparent background. Keep both landings unobstructed for connection to other sprites.
